_what: Voiceover takes for film B, synthesised 2026-10-24 in the user's ElevenLabs cloned voice 'eo' from script/voiceover.txt draft 2, numbers spelled out (tts_prompt.txt). Both takes are kept; build_vo.py builds audio/vo.wav from the chosen one.
_timings: Word timings came back from ElevenLabs with each take (speech-to-text node, 0 credits). Its text equals the prompt verbatim, so it is a forced alignment, NOT an independent check of the wording. The timings were checked against ffmpeg silencedetect at -35 dB: every sentence gap falls inside a measured silence.

take1.why: Chosen. Slower and more even (49.2 s); sentence gaps of 0.3-0.8 s give each number room to land.

take2.why: Kept. Rushed: lines 5-9 run together with gaps under 0.1 s, too fast for one count per beat.
